name: reshape
description: Close the gaps in a PRD by interviewing its owner, then writing the answers back into the PRD itself.

plugins.name: reshape
plugins.description: Reads a PRD plus its notes and team template, finds what a designer or engineer would otherwise have to guess, asks the critical questions one at a time with a recommended answer for each, and writes every answer back into the PRD with a decision log and owner-tagged open questions.
